KFYR (Radio station : Bismarck, N.D.)
spatial: United States; North Dakota; Burleigh County (N.D.); Bismarck (N.D.);
description: Cookbook of dishes from around the globe submitted by listeners of KFYR Radio 550 in Bismarck, North Dakota. Contents: American recipes, Bohemian recipes, Czechoslovakian recipes, Danish recipes, English recipes, Finnish recipes, French recipes, German recipes, Hungarian recipes, Greek recipes, Irish recipes, Italian recipes, Mexican recipes, Norwegian recipes, Oriental recipes, Russian recipes, Swedish recipes, and misc. recipes from many different countries.
